headline: BI Rate Rises and Leasing Companies Ask for Bigger Down Payments, Car Loans Harder to Get
summary: Buyers now need larger down payments for car loans after the Bank Indonesia rate increase. Rising non-performing loans have made leasing firms more selective in approving vehicle financing.
why: Bank Indonesia sets the country's benchmark interest rate, which feeds into consumer lending costs. Higher non-performing loans lead lenders to tighten credit standards.
original_headline: BI Rate Naik dan Leasing Minta DP Lebih Besar, Kredit Mobil Makin Susah
